# Review submission

**Related Astrid work:** Link the [Astrid-dev project plan](https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-dev/tree/main/plans) or [incident issue](https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-dev/issues). For a small independent fix, an issue link is enough; no project is required.

## Outcome and implementation
- **Claim:** What user-visible behavior changed or what problem was fixed?
- **Existing work reused:** Which implementation or contract did this build on?
- **Dependencies:** Exact upstream Runtime/Agent/App or other PRs and revisions, if applicable. This PR alone need not prove the whole project.

## Evidence and limits
- **Focused checks:** Actual commands or reproduction steps, tested candidate/environment and observed results (with links to logs or media when useful).
- **Failures and remaining gaps:** Regression/negative cases, limitations and risks to data, compatibility, security or rollback.
- **Review requested:** Code review / integration into a named branch / integrated candidate qualification (choose the relevant one).

[How Astrid contributions are reviewed](https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-dev/blob/main/docs/contribution-workflow.md). Reviewers inspect source and actual evidence; green CI alone is not deployment permission. A multi-repo project's final completion evidence is assessed in Astrid-dev, not inferred from each PR individually.
